lut_topology.replaces: 8-bit signed MAC at L1 Compute PE

lut_inventory.generation: bitnet.cpp reference table (Microsoft 2024) re-encoded for trit-native PE
lut_inventory.encoding_note: Each entry is a deterministic function of (x0,x1,x2,x3) in {-1,0,+1}^4. Output = sign(sum_i x_i) packed as 2 trits with saturation at +-1.
lut_inventory.verifier: scripts/verify_lut_npu.py (planned) -- enumerates all 81 (x0,x1,x2,x3) combos and asserts table[idx]==expected

predicates.method: Rust witness in tt-trinity-max-true:crates/tri1-lut-npu-witnesses runs BitNet b1.58-3B over WikiText-103 valid split (1000 sequences, ctx=2048) and reports fraction of (x0,x1,x2,x3) tuples whose LUT-NPU lookup hits a SPARSE_SKIP-eligible slot (output trits == (0,0))
predicates.consequences_if_fail: Wave-35 REJECTED, TOPS/W projection 270 retracted, fallback to Wave-34 225 baseline; LUT-NPU PE replaced with vanilla MAC for TTIHP27a tape-out

predicates.method: RTL simulation iverilog over rtl/lut_npu_pe.sv -- 100 random (x0,x1,x2,x3) inputs, all must produce stable output trits within 1 clock cycle (no multi-cycle ROM stall)
predicates.consequences_if_fail: Wave-35 REJECTED, LUT-NPU is not a 1-cycle replacement for MAC, defeats the energy projection

predicates.method: Yosys read_verilog rtl/lut_npu_pe.sv -- after synth_sky130 stat must report 0 occurrences of $mul, $mod, $div, $shr, $shl
predicates.consequences_if_fail: Wave-35 REJECTED, LUT-NPU violates R-SI-1 (no Kleene-star equivalent in RTL)

predicates.method: Yosys synth_sky130 -top lut_npu_pe stat -- reported cell count must be <= 350 (vs 800 for vanilla 8-bit MAC PE)
predicates.consequences_if_fail: Wave-35 REJECTED, area projection +0.18 mm^2 was a lie

quantum_brain_mapping.lang_to_si: OP_LUT_NPU = 0xE3 extends sacred alphabet to 8 opcodes (0xDE..0xE3)
quantum_brain_mapping.bio_to_si: L1 Compute opcode; L2 ROM microcode block reuses Lever #2 BitROM bidirectional macro; no L0 Sacred ROM cell consumed
